title: 32-inch Gravel Gains Steam with New Tires from Continental and Rene Herse
content:
The tire offerings from both big and small brands build on the rumors that 32-inch wheel gravel bikes from big brands will be rolling out early next year.

Read the full article at 32-inch Gravel Gains Steam with New Tires from Continental and Rene Herse on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
